purpose: Shared structured rejections, remedies, and reusable prevention lessons across all Atlas automations. This is persisted feedback, not model weight training.

lessons.rule: Before commit, show the actual full-size source subject and verify every headline noun/verb appears in the photo or source-supported context; do not use images as generic substitutes.
Before rendering/download, reject new v7 slides whose activity_source is absent or not in the fact_sources list; include unit test.
Re-fetch Metricool on each research, production, review and recovery run; mutate the ledger immediately after confirmed PENDING/PUBLISHED. Scheduled entries override stale RENDERED_PENDING_QA labels.
Every animal-related overlay must be challenged against actual image: soaring vs perched, flock vs one or two, wading vs flying; wording should not imply the photo shows what it doesn't.
Closing image must be deliberately beautiful and emotionally coherent with the story, not a dark stripe or blank sky. QA can reject even a correctly licensed photo.
When replacing a source asset, update manifest source, author, license, credits, caption and all hashes together; invalidate previous QA verdict and check public credit consistency preflight.

note: After each QA failure add a new event immediately; when resolved update status and evidence. An unresolved event must appear in open_revisions and be first action for next production/recovery run. Source mutations demand a new render and full QA.
